notes: No-answer WhatsApp: the message is now written for you from the deal and stage — who you are, why you called, and when to call back — instead of 14 presets.
Purpose, tone and callback-window chips regenerate it; tap the bubble to edit.
New: Remind me to call back creates a callback task from the same sheet (+2h, next morning, or a time you pick).
Missed incoming calls get a proper 'sorry I missed your call' reply; a second attempt the same day sends a short nudge without re-introducing yourself.
Accounts marked Not Interested are no longer chased.
